findings.message: Visible bridge stairs and rails use generic collider boxes rather than matching collision geometry; replace them with authored dimensions or limited static mesh shapes and add bidirectional traversal coverage.
The wet-bank ribbon is globally offset by 0.208m and floats above terrain outside the flat opening; terrain-ground the outer bank and lift only the inner edge to the water surface.
The opening still reads as a sparse prototype: bare repeated ground, lollipop-tree rows and test-piece shrubs do not meet the layered forest clearing criterion.
The default blue-uniform hero contradicts the approved Ziemek/Gniewko direction; VS-046 must deliver concept-derived rig appearances and live captures.
A 0.62 shadowless FillLight is active throughout the day as well as night; make it time-of-day responsive and prove night route readability in rendered evidence.
The camera evidence still reads as a flat dark river strip; make shallow/deep contrast and directional motion visible from shore, bridge and in-water viewpoints.
Focused structural tests pass but emit cleanup warnings and do not prove bridge traversal; live evidence remains the acceptance authority.
